what: A backing band to play over: drums, bass, chords and a synth line follow a chord progression in Nashville numbers, in any key and time signature, in time with a loop pedal's MIDI clock. Indie first, then rock, folk, soul, funk, blues, hip hop and more. 38 factory jams, GENERATE by genre, a user drum kit, and a companion web app to edit, save and share jams.
author: PhilipsKnobs
